_meta.note: cfbenchmarks_value msg payload per the channel's jsonPayloadSchema (required: index_id, received_at, data, avg_60s_data; last_60s_windowed_average_15min optional, 'present only in the final minute before quarter-hour close' - included here because it IS the settlement quantity for the KXBTC15M family). `data` is documented only as 'the raw CF Benchmarks JSON frame, as a string' - upstream CF format, of which the app reads `value` (the untouched index level).
